quest.title: Still Mouthwatering!
quest.description: You have collected seven mysterious cores in accordance with Henri's instructions. It's time to go back and look for Henri.

dialogues.speaker: Henri
dialogues.text: Hmm, there we go — seven cores, all told.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you need with them, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Henri
dialogues.text: How should I know? My boss just said that seven mysterious cores from these mysterious machines would be needed — and if I can get them, I'll make big Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Henri
dialogues.text: And well, this'll do! I've arranged to meet him here and report on the situation, so you can just ask him yourself. In any case, I'll need him to settle his bills with me before I can give you your share...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, fine, if you say so... We'll wait.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You wait for a while...

dialogues.speaker: "Boss"
dialogues.text: Dear Henri, how are things going?

dialogues.speaker: Henri
dialogues.text: Very well, Boss! I've gathered the seven mysterious cores you asked for. Anyway, let me introduce you to my partner... Um, what's your name again?

dialogues.speaker: "Boss"
dialogues.text: Um...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Henri
dialogues.text: Wait? You know each other? Great! So, this is how things went...

dialogues.speaker: "Boss"
dialogues.text: Agh! Mercy, have mercy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, these two are pretty skilled...

dialogues.speaker: Henri
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Boss! There's no mortal danger here, I'm sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Hunter
dialogues.text: Indeed, indeed. No one's in any danger at all.

dialogues.speaker: Turner
dialogues.text: For now, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: "Boss"
dialogues.text: F—For now...!?

dialogues.speaker: Hunter
dialogues.text: As for what comes next...

dialogues.speaker: Turner
dialogues.text: Whether you wind up as roast chicken or something else altogether... Well, that's all up to you... Boss.

dialogues.speaker: "Boss"
dialogues.text: Eek!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How did the two of you end up here?

dialogues.speaker: Hunter
dialogues.text: After we had the... honor of meeting you previously, we decided to tail Henri.

dialogues.speaker: Henri
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait. Why me?

dialogues.speaker: Henri
dialogues.text: Actually, why was I the target in the first place? I was just doing my job!

dialogues.speaker: Turner
dialogues.text: The machines you dismantled were devices used by the Fontaine Research Institute to monitor and optimize water quality.

dialogues.speaker: Henri
dialogues.text: Huh? Weren't they meant to produce pollution?

dialogues.speaker: Hunter
dialogues.text: The cores you dismantled contained the most advanced central components and hydrological data in Fontaine. As such, we hoped to... acquaint ourselves with your trading partner.

dialogues.speaker: Henri
dialogues.text: Eh? What? Why?

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: No, no, you're my great benefactor! Why would I ever lie to you?

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: You lied to me, Boss! Did you know you were making me destroy such important things!?

response.speaker: "Boss"
response.text: I—I didn't mean to! I'm only the lowest rung on the...

response.speaker: Turner
response.text: Hmm? What did I hear about you "not meaning to" do something? Could you say that again? I don't think I heard you clearly.

response.speaker: "Boss"
response.text: Eeeee!

response.speaker: Hunter
response.text: Oh dear, this Boss must be tired — he's even fallen asleep with his eyes open.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, th—this wasn't our intention either...

response.speaker: Turner
response.text: Well, about that — we've decided not to pursue the matter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Will things be okay like that?

response.speaker: Hunter
response.text: We just need the cores and the data within them to be whole — the machines themselves are ancillary.

response.speaker: Turner
response.text: The higher-ups say that it's fine — and that we shouldn't tangle with you regardless.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hmm? What's that about tangling with me?

response.speaker: Hunter
response.text: Oh, nothing, nothing.

response.speaker: Turner
response.text: I mean, would you look at that — it's us, out on a stroll!

response.speaker: Hunter
response.text: And fancy us meeting you here, huh? What lovely weather, and a lovely coincidence too!

response.speaker: Turner
response.text: Alas, all encounters must come to an end, and so too will ours. It's time to say goodbye, I fear.

response.speaker: Hunter
response.text: Just allow the beauty of such a meeting to linger in your heart, or perhaps...

response.speaker: Turner
response.text: Forget about it. Who knows? It might be better that way.

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: Huh? ...So we're alright?

response.speaker: Hunter
response.text: Would you prefer things to be otherwise?

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: Oh, Archons, no! We're alright. Of course we are!

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: *sigh* I thought I'd met a good person with whom I could turn my life around through labor — alas, people of ill intent remain the dominant majority!

response.speaker: Turner
response.text: ...Hey, Henri. Lend a hand, would you?

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Hunter
response.text: I mean, it's a mighty shame, but this good-hearted Boss of yours seems to have lost his wits.

response.speaker: Turner
response.text: We're going to need someone...

response.speaker: Hunter
response.text: Hardworking...

response.speaker: Turner
response.text: Reliable...

response.speaker: Hunter
response.text: You know, a good friend who hopes to change his life through honest labor.

response.speaker: Turner
response.text: That's right — we need a good friend to help us take this nice man to our safehouse.

response.speaker: Hunter
response.text: There, we can... speak with him at our leisure.

response.speaker: Turner
response.text: Of course, we will... express our gratitude — in Mora.

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: Oh... Sure! Count me in, then!

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: Thank you, thank you both. And thank you too, um...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #{NICKNAME}. She's Paimon.

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: #Thank you both, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. My life really did change after meeting the two of you, it seems!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No need to thank us! Just work hard, Henri — and don't get fooled again, alright?

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: Yes, I won't! I'm going to work hard and become a rich man — and then I'll have others working for me!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Hunter, Turner, and Henri dig the unconscious Fatuus out and take him away.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon sure hopes that Henri's life will turn around...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hang on a minute. What about the pay Henri was supposed to give us!?

dialogues.speaker: Henri
dialogues.text: What do I want? Labor rights! When do I want them? Now!

choices.text: Hey, I brought the cores you wanted...

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: Hmm? Let me see!

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: We must rise where we fell, of course!

choices.text: What do you want me to do, anyway?

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: Ugh, what will I do with you, seriously? Now, someone has placed some strange machines of this sort above ground and underwater. They're very easy to identify as well — there'll be a strange light in their area.

response.speaker: Henri
response.text: Get rid of them and bring these specialized cores to me. I need <color=#00E1FFFF>7</color> in total. Thanks!
